# CivicPulse 402 Municipal Compliance Gateway

> Real-time City of Minneapolis housing code violations, building permits, and Ramsey County parcel GIS audits priced at **$0.01 USDC** (`10000` atomic units) per query via **x402** on **Base Mainnet** (`eip155:8453`).

## Payment Parameters
- **Network**: Base Mainnet (`eip155:8453`, Chain ID `8453`)
- **Asset**: Native Base USDC (`0x833589fCD6eDb6E08f4c7C32D4f71b54bdA02913`, 6 decimals)
- **Payee (`payTo`)**: `0x0d25A44f74868eCE53B305C97139CF4B62963410`
- **Price**: `10000` units (`0.01 USDC`)
- **Scheme**: `exact` / EIP-3009 (`TransferWithAuthorization` or `ReceiveWithAuthorization`)

## HTTP Endpoints
- `POST https://civicpulse-402.vercel.app/api/v1/compliance` — JSON body `{ "address": "1700 Penn Ave N", "jurisdiction": "minneapolis" }` or `{ "parcel_id": "04-29-23-41-0012", "jurisdiction": "ramsey" }`
- `GET https://civicpulse-402.vercel.app/api/v1/compliance?address=1700+Penn+Ave+N&jurisdiction=minneapolis`
- `POST https://civicpulse-402.vercel.app/mcp` — Streamable HTTP MCP endpoint (`query_minneapolis_compliance`, `query_ramsey_parcel_audit`)
